name: K-CheckupDx-Bench
description: Evaluation data and tooling for tiered determination (Normal A / Normal B / suspected disease) in the Korean National Health Screening Program, derived entirely from published criteria. Includes a 144-case tier set, a 528-case / 6,321-pair value-ladder set for the label-independent monotonicity violation metric, a 54-case BMI source-ambiguity set, a deterministic rule engine that re-derives every gold label, and a documented confound audit trail.
